verified_contracts.details: Nineteen ordered independently SHA/length-pinned original references are closed and bounded. Descriptor and all inputs are rechecked before/after each observed operation. Existing receipt chains join the published observation, original head/preparation/constructor reports, source records, historical request/driver, both singleton bundles and original checkpoint bytes. Old driver receipt Path/hash constants are inspected through a restricted AST-only evaluator.

Calls match current SourceSampleRecord.from_dict, build_us_code_sample, TargetSnapshotConfig.from_dict, load_target_bundle, TargetBundle.targets_for/close, ModalAutoencoderTrainingState.from_dict, existing full model constructor and private supplied-target/cache/readout helpers. The full historical constructor field set matches the current signature. Payload uses target_view_distributions_by_sample, target_losses_by_sample, target_hashes and target_count.

The probe preserves historical target configuration instead of generating a new current-source target configuration. Both requested singleton targets fully hydrate under existing 64MiB shard limits, with independently retained expanded-byte/hash commitments and an aggregate128MiB bound. Exact two original rows and target supports4/6 are required. Complete supplied targets prevent fresh bridge generation through the inspected payload branch.

Parent and accepted structural384 checkpoints use the same original constructor and copied full compiler target/loss context; equal evaluator_context_sha256 is required. The fixed-seven diagnostic runs first on its isolated copy, then the unchanged dynamic-support/clamped CE readout runs separately. Actual loaded-state identities are checked after readout. Caller checkpoint context is explicitly a declaration; the probe preserves externally pinned source/checkpoint references and does not infer authenticated metadata from the diagnostic.

The probe requires an empty native-owned private exports directory, exclusive flat0600 files, aggregate16MiB output bound, readback hashes, closed inventory and fsync. Source/sample, target/context, profile, paired checkpoint reports, receipt and self-excluded file index are retained. Native durability, process lifecycle and resource release remain owner responsibilities.

The probe reads two repeatedly inspected tuning rows and saved parent/accepted structural state. It does not recover rejected view proposals, train, encode, call a full decoder, execute a native compiler/solver, authenticate legal meaning or supply independent holdout evidence. Official acceptance/training/Pareto/rollback and original artifacts remain unchanged.
